vsam.why: base/cntl/adef121.jcl DEFINE2: DATA(... KEYS(21 0) RECORDSIZE(64 64)); the engine's facts do not read KEYS / RECORDSIZE inside the DATA component, so the case states them

notes: Generated-row sibling (#4507) of genapp-lgupdb01: CUSTOMER, POLICY and the ENDOWMENT / HOUSE / MOTOR / COMMERCIAL tables are generated from base/cntl/db2cre.jcl (the same generate block as genapp-lgipdb01-generated: identity policy numbers 1000001..1000012 (the requests carry them), FKs POLICY->CUSTOMER and type->POLICY, NULLs and boundary values), not GenApp's INSERTs. The scenarios are written against those seed 4507 rows: each names a customer, a policy and the row's LASTCHANGED (the optimistic lock) as the generated POLICY row holds it; LGUPVS01's KSDSPOLY (ksdspoly.txt) holds a record for each policy that reaches it. Covered: the three types on generated policies, the lowest and highest timestamps, a NULL BROKERID and a NULL BROKERSREFERENCE read through their indicators, a stale LASTCHANGED ('02'), a request for a type the policy does not hold (+100 '01'), a wrong customer and an unknown policy (FETCH +100). Not generated: policies 4 and 5, whose ISSUEDATE / EXPIRYDATE are NULL (the FETCH has no indicator for them: -305, '90', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ, oracle_assumptions.md X6), and the paths on which LGUPVS01 fails. Fault and length paths (#6072): no COMMAREA and a short one (`commarea_length`), a failing OPEN (-913 and a hard SQLCODE), a failing CLOSE (+501 and a hard SQLCODE) and an unknown request id, each injected through `sql_faults` where it is a Db2 outcome; WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ (`programs` and `region`). With those, every branch outcome of LGUPDB01 is taken (38/38). A change to the generator's draw moves the rows: the E2E test in tests/cobol_mainframe/test_equivalence_db2_rows.py fails the case then. Program, LINKed LGUPVS01 and the LGCMAREA COMMAREA as in genapp-lgupdb01.

scenarios.name: open-cursor-fails
scenarios.why: OPEN POLICY_CURSOR answers -904 (resource unavailable): the OTHER arm, '90', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE with a full COMMAREA, RETURN (on generated policy 1000010)

scenarios.name: close-cursor-fails-501
scenarios.why: CLOSE POLICY_CURSOR answers -501 (cursor not open): '00', RETURN without the final LINK of LGUPVS01 (on generated policy 1000010)

scenarios.name: close-cursor-fails-other
scenarios.why: CLOSE POLICY_CURSOR answers -904: the OTHER arm, '90', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE, RETURN (on generated policy 1000010)

scenarios.name: short-commarea-open-fails
scenarios.why: a 40-byte COMMAREA (header and the customer and policy numbers): the entry reads nothing past byte 28 before OPEN fails, so WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE copies the whole 40 bytes (IF EIBCALEN < 91 true) (on generated policy 1000010)

scenarios.name: unknown-request-id
scenarios.why: LASTCHANGED matches on generated policy 1000010 but the request id names no policy type: the EVALUATE (line 283) has no WHEN OTHER, so no type table is updated and the POLICY row still is
